leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Construct an Axios instance with custom configuration for API requests
Apply Axios interceptors to modify request headers before they are sent
Implement response interceptors to handle API error responses
Execute conditional logic to detect authentication errors based on status codes
Define a refresh token function that makes a POST request to obtain new tokens
Utilize async/await syntax to manage asynchronous token refresh operations
Store and retrieve authentication tokens from browser storage (localStorage/sessionStorage)
Control request retry logic by intercepting failed requests and refreshing tokens
Modify request headers to include refreshed access tokens before retrying
Handle race conditions by implementing request queueing during token refresh
Return appropriate error responses when token refresh fails or credentials are invalid
Apply TypeScript interfaces to define types for authentication tokens and API responses
